overview.description: The 21Shares XRP ETF Beneficial INT SH (TOXR) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in long xrp, short usd currency. The fund provides exposure to the daily price movements, net of expenses, of the US dollar price of XRP (XRP) through an ETF structure. The Custodian holds most XRPs and their private keys in cold storage (offline) TOXR was launched on Dec 11, 2025 and is issued by 21Shares.
